meta.name: env-and-assets-bootstrap
meta.description: Rigor Setup skill for README-first deep learning repo reproduction. Use when the task is specifically to prepare a conservative conda-first environment, checkpoint and dataset path assumptions, cache location hints, and setup notes before any run on a README-documented repository. Do not use for repo scanning, full orchestration, paper interpretation, final run reporting, or generic environment setup that is not tied to a specific reproduction target.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跑开源深度学习项目前,先把运行环境、权重与数据路径备好
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果拿到一个深度学习仓库却卡在环境与路径配置上
copy.tagline_en: Prepare environment, checkpoints, and data paths before running a deep learning repo
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a deep learning repo won't run and you're stuck on setup and paths

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先做运行前的准备:给出保守的 conda 建环境步骤和候选命令、checkpoint 与数据集的路径安排及来源提示,并列出尚未解决的依赖或资源风险。它不负责扫描仓库、选目标或最终报告。
howto.when: 当仓库排查后已确定一个可复现目标、需要在跑命令前建环境或准备资源路径时接管;仓库依赖 checkpoint、数据集等目录,或用户明确要运行前的搭建帮助时也会用。

say.text: 为这个 README 仓库准备保守的 conda 环境和建环境命令
say.note: 产出保守的搭建步骤与候选 conda 命令

say.text: 先规划这个仓库的 checkpoint 和数据集路径与来源
say.note: 给出资源路径计划与来源提示

say.text: 跑之前先列出还没解决的依赖和资源风险
say.note: 输出未决依赖与资源风险清单

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude prepares pre-run setup: conservative conda steps and candidate commands, checkpoint and dataset path plans with source hints, and unresolved dependency or asset risks. It does not scan repos or write final reports.
howto.when_en: Triggers once repo intake identifies a credible target, when environment creation or asset path prep is needed before running commands, or when the repo depends on checkpoints or datasets.

say_en.text: Prepare a conservative conda environment and setup commands for this repo
say_en.note: Yields conservative setup steps and candidate conda commands

say_en.text: Plan the checkpoint and dataset paths and sources for this repo first
say_en.note: Returns an asset path plan with source hints

say_en.text: List unresolved dependency and asset risks before any run
say_en.note: Returns a list of unresolved risks
